scope: Rank-0 checks of why capacity all-reduce kernel durations increase during backward recomputation.

observations.kernel_configuration: All39: identical AllReduce_Sum_u64_RING_LL,128Long inputs,8ranks,grid1,block128,119040 shared bytes.
observations.interpretation: Local input work completes just before collective start; local compute resumes just after collective end. These are observed event boundaries, not reconstructed CUDA event dependencies. No other recorded local device work overlaps these collectives.

official_nccl_reference.mechanism: A launched NCCL kernel may wait until all communicator ranks have launched the collective.

causal_status: Rank0/1 both show long backward kernels and almost simultaneous ends. Peer arrival/resource/protocol waiting is a plausible explanation; ranks2-7 are unavailable, so late arrival versus fabric/protocol/resource delay cannot be resolved.
implication: Removing replayed capacity collectives does not establish equivalent step-time saving: peer waiting may be encountered at the subsequent EP dispatch.

queries.label: same_capacity_kernel_configuration
queries.sql:
SELECT name,
EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.In msg nelems') nelems,
EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.dtype') dtype,
EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.Group size') nranks,
EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.grid[0]') grid_x,
EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.block[0]') block_x,
EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.shared memory') shared_bytes,
COUNT(*) n
FROM thread_slice
WHERE category='kernel' AND name GLOB 'ncclDevKernel_AllReduce_Sum_u64*'
AND CAST(EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.In msg nelems') AS INT)=128
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7;

queries.label: selected_local_compute_and_collective_edges
queries.sql:
WITH targets AS (SELECT * FROM thread_slice WHERE id IN (58892,60411))
SELECT t.id AS collective_id,s.id,s.name,s.category,EXTRACT_ARG(s.arg_set_id,'args.stream') stream,
(s.ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 start_ms,s.dur/1e6 dur_ms
FROM targets t JOIN thread_slice s ON s.category IN ('kernel','gpu_memcpy','gpu_memset')
AND s.ts+s.dur>=t.ts-150000 AND s.ts<=t.ts+t.dur+150000
ORDER BY t.id,s.ts LIMIT 90;
